svg.title: 无人车贴花覆膜设计方案 v4
svg.desc: Wrap/decal v4 — full white-body eco-wave style (reference-inspired). Uses all blank white upper-body on left+right elevations. Never covers gray chassis, right display screen+outer seam (890,2300 1330×920), warning tape, handles, wheels, roof/drone equipment. Left clip: main+pillar (990, 250, 2270, 1080) ∪ rear hatch (310, 690, 700, 650). Right clip: multi-rect union around screen hole (890, 2300, 1330, 920) within (300, 2210, 2960, 1070). Organic overlapping green waves lower ~45–55%; upper brand; city+trees+water+leaves. Colors: primary #009A2C, support #007A24, accent #4CAF50, lime #8BC34A, forest #1B5E20, water #81D4FA, soft #E8F5E9. Logo paths embedded (self-contained).

g.title: 无人车左右侧视线框
g.desc: Autonomous boxy vehicle orthographic left+right side elevations only. Scale 1 user unit = 1 mm. L=3000 H=1700 W=1100. Rear L-cutout depth≈690mm (估测), shelf height≈1260mm (估测); rear white face VERTICAL. Front (车头) white-body slant ≈6.0° from vertical (inset 120mm / WHITE_H). Right side: display screen ≈1330×920mm + seam band (non-decal). Left: solid panel. Red/silver 警示贴条 on rear L corners only (non-decal; 车头无警示条). Lower chassis filled #c8c8c8 = non-decal. No front view, no top view.

g.text: 注：仅左侧视（上，车头朝右）+ 右侧视（下，车头朝左）。斜切在车头（≈6.0°/内收120mm）；后缘垂直 + L 形开缺；无人机机场嵌于凹台内。开缺深≈690mm、台面高≈1260mm 据紫线实测；斜度据紫线估测。

g.text: 非贴花：灰底盘 / 右侧显示屏+安装缝 / 红银警示贴条（仅后 L 角，车头无警示条）。虚线框=可贴花区。左侧实心门板大可贴花区。无前视/俯视。
